bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 60
cd "$root"
PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 - <<'PY'
import asyncio, os, pathlib, stat, sys
from userbot_test_client import invoke
from userbot_session import SESSION_BASE
session=SESSION_BASE.with_suffix(".session")
if not session.is_file() or session.is_symlink() or stat.S_IMODE(session.stat().st_mode)!=0o600: sys.exit(61)
try:
 result=asyncio.run(invoke("report_recipient_id"))
except Exception: sys.exit(62)
if result.get("status")!="PASS": sys.exit(63)
recipient=result.get("recipient_id")
if type(recipient)!=int or not 10000<=recipient<2**53: sys.exit(64)
target=pathlib.Path("deploy/secrets/bug_report_recipient.txt")
if target.is_symlink(): sys.exit(65)
target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
fd=os.open(target,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_TRUNC|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600)
with os.fdopen(fd,"w") as f:
 f.write(str(recipient)+"\n")
 f.flush()
 os.fsync(f.fileno())
if stat.S_IMODE(target.stat().st_mode)!=0o600:sys.exit(66)
print("REPORT_RECIPIENT_CONFIGURED=YES")
PY
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 67
